{"chapter_id":"5B","issues":[{"question_id":"5B.1","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0001-E001","BATCH-0009-E001","BATCH-0015-E003","BATCH-0010-E005"],"explanation":"These sources support stated agendas and formal priorities, but not the draft's stronger characterization of a genuine broad-development program or its pursuit of broad welfare rather than rents or loyalty purchases."},{"question_id":"5B.1","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0007-E001","BATCH-0007-E002"],"explanation":"Official fiscal reports describe tax relief and spending, but do not independently establish that the measures were executed effectively or personally attributable to Xi."},{"question_id":"5B.1","issue_type":"misleading_weight","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0018-E005","BATCH-0018-E006","BATCH-0023-E013","BATCH-0023-E014"],"explanation":"Aggregate GDP, income, consumption, employment, and trade indicators receive substantial positive weight despite the question requiring policy choice, implementation, breadth, and sustainability; the same evidence does not establish those dimensions."},{"question_id":"5B.1","issue_type":"irrelevant_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0002-E002"],"explanation":"Exit bans and intimidation of activists and journalists concern political repression and do not directly evidence the economic agenda, rents, budgets, or prosperity."},{"question_id":"5B.2","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0006-E012"],"explanation":"Reuters reports retention of Yi Gang and Liu Kun and analyst interpretations of continuity and professionalism, but not credible appointment procedures, operational independence, or performance-based retention."},{"question_id":"5B.2","issue_type":"irrelevant_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0021-E006","BATCH-0021-E007"],"explanation":"A payment-institution regulation effective in 2024 establishes qualification and governance requirements for firms; it does not evidence Xi's appointment or empowerment of economic professionals."},{"question_id":"5B.2","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0005-E009","BATCH-0009-E004","BATCH-0009-E005"],"explanation":"These sources support centralization, factional promotion, and loyalist appointments, but the draft's conclusion that loyalty constrained selection and independence is an inference not directly demonstrated for the economic officials at issue."},{"question_id":"5B.2","issue_type":"period_error","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0021-E006","BATCH-0021-E007"],"explanation":"The cited rules were scheduled to take effect on May 1, 2024, so they cannot establish 2023 implementation or 2023 operational independence."},{"question_id":"5B.3","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0007-E002","BATCH-0003-E002","BATCH-0007-E006","BATCH-0012-E007"],"explanation":"These sources show budget figures, reported execution, debt-management rules, and formal regulations, but do not establish compliance with credible fiscal, monetary, or financial rules or protection of long-term investment."},{"question_id":"5B.3","issue_type":"period_error","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0021-E006","BATCH-0021-E007"],"explanation":"The payment regulation was promulgated in 2023 but was not effective until 2024; the draft appropriately notes this limitation but still uses the measures as part of the affirmative evidentiary basis."},{"question_id":"5B.3","issue_type":"missing_contrary_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0022-E007","BATCH-0022-E008","BATCH-0026-E010","BATCH-0026-E011"],"explanation":"The answer mentions debt and property risks but omits or underweights the broader evidence of falling private investment, declining profits, capacity underuse, and deteriorating real-estate indicators when characterizing stabilization."},{"question_id":"5B.4","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0018-E005","BATCH-0018-E006","BATCH-0003-E011"],"explanation":"Market entities, trade, manufacturing, and administrative-reconsideration counts do not demonstrate fair, predictable, and consistently enforced competition, property, labor, trade, or investment rules."},{"question_id":"5B.4","issue_type":"period_error","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0012-E009","BATCH-0019-E002"],"explanation":"The revised standards regulations took effect in June 2024 and the Administrative Reconsideration Law took effect in January 2024; their 2023 enactment cannot establish 2023 enforcement or outcomes."},{"question_id":"5B.4","issue_type":"missing_contrary_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0010-E028","BATCH-0022-E014","BATCH-0022-E004"],"explanation":"The answer cites these generally, but does not fully integrate the foreign-business raids, vague counter-espionage rules, and private-investment divergence as evidence against predictability and equal treatment."},{"question_id":"5B.5","issue_type":"misleading_weight","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0003-E007","BATCH-0003-E009","BATCH-0004-E009","BATCH-0004-E010"],"explanation":"Investigation, sanction, and case counts demonstrate enforcement activity, not impartial enforcement, recovered losses, due process, net corruption reduction, or action against politically connected actors."},{"question_id":"5B.5","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0007-E003","BATCH-0007-E006"],"explanation":"Austerity rules, debt monitoring, and reported accountability cases do not establish effective procurement enforcement, disclosure compliance, independent audits, or remedies for capture."},{"question_id":"5B.5","issue_type":"missing_contrary_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0008-E005","BATCH-0010-E028","BATCH-0022-E014"],"explanation":"The draft should more explicitly connect politically connected firms receiving favorable social-credit treatment and raids or legal uncertainty affecting foreign firms to the question's politically connected privilege and capture test."},{"question_id":"5B.6","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0013-E006","BATCH-0025-E023","BATCH-0016-E009","BATCH-0026-E013"],"explanation":"Education spending, school places, health-insurance enrollment, and R&D figures are inputs or administrative outputs; they do not establish timely completion, quality, productivity, or non-patronage implementation."},{"question_id":"5B.6","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0020-E001","BATCH-0020-E002"],"explanation":"County-reported elder-care and assistance projects show local activity but cannot establish national infrastructure or service quality, and Xi attribution is indirect."},{"question_id":"5B.6","issue_type":"missing_contrary_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0008-E003","BATCH-0009-E008","BATCH-0026-E011","BATCH-0026-E014"],"explanation":"The answer mentions guidance-fund underperformance, semiconductor shortfalls, property problems, and coal use, but does not adequately weigh these against the claimed capacity-building and durability of investment."},{"question_id":"5B.7","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0003-E002","BATCH-0003-E005","BATCH-0003-E010","BATCH-0007-E006"],"explanation":"Official reporting, final accounts, audits, and performance-management rules establish disclosure and oversight mechanisms, not reliable information, independent evaluation, or willingness to publish adverse results."},{"question_id":"5B.7","issue_type":"misleading_weight","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0004-E001","BATCH-0004-E002","BATCH-0007-E013"],"explanation":"The zero-COVID reversal is treated as evidence of correction, but the cited evidence expressly leaves motivation unresolved and indicates the reversal followed protest and political pressure; it does not demonstrate evidence-based monitoring or transparent correction."},{"question_id":"5B.7","issue_type":"missing_contrary_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0022-E015","BATCH-0018-E006","BATCH-0021-E016"],"explanation":"The draft should give greater decisive weight to the absence of an official zero-COVID investigation, censorship of economic and political reporting, and manipulation of information around Xi's reappointment."},{"question_id":"5B.8","issue_type":"misleading_weight","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0023-E013","BATCH-0018-E007","BATCH-0025-E022"],"explanation":"Per-capita income, urban-rural ratios, and enrollment aggregates are used as favorable distributional outcomes, but they do not establish actual incidence across gender, hukou, disability, ethnicity, or region."},{"question_id":"5B.8","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0009-E001","BATCH-0011-E011","BATCH-0011-E012","BATCH-0021-E010"],"explanation":"Formal common-prosperity goals, subsidies, and statutory protections do not establish that gains and burdens were distributed fairly in actual incidence or that programs reached intended recipients."},{"question_id":"5B.8","issue_type":"missing_contrary_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0026-E015","BATCH-0026-E016","BATCH-0026-E017","BATCH-0026-E018"],"explanation":"The answer mentions disability and unequal access generally but omits the documented certification gap, low and geographically variable benefits, government-controlled advocacy structures, and rural healthcare disadvantage."},{"question_id":"5B.9","issue_type":"unsupported_claim","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0007-E001","BATCH-0007-E002","BATCH-0011-E011","BATCH-0011-E012"],"explanation":"Tax relief, disaster bonds, price subsidies, and assistance allocations show announced or administratively reported measures, but not adequate targeting, timely delivery nationally, monitoring, or correction."},{"question_id":"5B.9","issue_type":"period_error","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0010-E016","BATCH-0007-E013"],"explanation":"The zero-COVID exit and most associated mortality occurred in late 2022; the answer uses this as a 2023 shock-response record without sufficiently separating inherited policy failure, January 2023 mortality, and 2023 response."},{"question_id":"5B.9","issue_type":"misleading_weight","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0018-E005","BATCH-0018-E006","BATCH-0023-E013","BATCH-0019-E007"],"explanation":"Recovery in growth, employment, income, retail activity, and low inflation is treated as evidence of response competence even though reopening and external demand are not isolated from policy effects and the question requires targeted, monitored, and corrected measures."},{"question_id":"5B.9","issue_type":"missing_contrary_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0026-E011","BATCH-0017-E015","BATCH-0006-E001","BATCH-0004-E020","BATCH-0004-E021"],"explanation":"The answer should more fully integrate property deterioration, unresolved local debt, youth unemployment, unpaid-wage and housing protests, and weak labor protections as evidence of incomplete shock management."},{"question_id":"5B.10","issue_type":"period_error","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0018-E005","BATCH-0018-E006","BATCH-0018-E007","BATCH-0026-E009"],"explanation":"The answer compares 2023 with the immediate pandemic baseline and calls the trajectory stronger, but the guide requires an inherited-baseline and durable trajectory assessment; reopening effects and pre-existing reforms cannot be treated as Xi-era improvement without a longer counterfactual."},{"question_id":"5B.10","issue_type":"misleading_weight","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0018-E005","BATCH-0018-E006","BATCH-0018-E007","BATCH-0026-E009"],"explanation":"Official aggregate improvements receive more evidentiary emphasis than their limitations warrant, despite the sources' lack of independent verification and causal attribution."},{"question_id":"5B.10","issue_type":"missing_contrary_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0026-E008","BATCH-0026-E010","BATCH-0026-E011","BATCH-0026-E014","BATCH-0017-E015"],"explanation":"The answer lists structural weaknesses but does not clearly treat population decline, falling profits and private/property investment, coal dependence, and unresolved debt sustainability as potentially decisive constraints on a durable stronger trajectory."},{"question_id":"5B.10","issue_type":"irrelevant_evidence","evidence_ids":["BATCH-0010-E024"],"explanation":"The Xinjiang detention and minority-rights evidence is relevant to distribution and exclusion in a broad welfare assessment, but the draft places it as a direct qualification of the economic trajectory without explaining the economic mechanism or material welfare consequence."}],"overall_assessment":"The ten answers generally identify important uncertainty and contrary evidence, but they repeatedly give positive weight to official plans, administrative outputs, and aggregate macroeconomic indicators that do not establish implementation quality, fairness, independent verification, or Xi-specific attribution. Several cited laws and regulations were not effective during 2023, and the trajectory answer relies too heavily on a post-pandemic comparison rather than an inherited-baseline and durability test."}
